description: Sun exposure in outdoor workers is a dataset listed in Alberta open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Jobs, Economy and Northern Development. Contains data collected in support of a study to measure the exposure to solar ultraviolet radiation of outdoor workers in Alberta. The dataset contains dosimeter readings and measurements of solar ultraviolet radiation exposure, as well as other relevant metrics. Coverage: Alberta. The portal files it under the publisher Jobs, Economy and Northern Development. Its tags are OHS Futures, OHS Futures Research Funding Program, Occupational Health and Safety Futures Research Funding Program, UVR, occupational health hazards. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2026-06-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Alberta. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-alberta-portal.
